title: Data source
description: A survey, register, database, statistical product or unit that source metadata names as the origin of data, owned by an organisation where known.

owner.description: Organisation id that runs or publishes the data source; null when unknown.

aliases.description: Raw strings from source metadata that denote this data source, after the organisation part has been removed.

seen_in.description: Adapters or owners whose metadata mention it.

cited_by.description: Organisation ids whose datasets cite this data source as their origin.
